beats.text: Same routine for octane, a component of petrol. Eight carbons give eight carbon dioxide. Eighteen hydrogens give nine water.

Oxygen in the products: sixteen in the carbon dioxide plus nine in the water, twenty-five atoms. Octane contains no oxygen, so all twenty-five come from oxygen gas: twelve and a half molecules. Doubling gives two octane plus twenty-five oxygen forming sixteen carbon dioxide plus eighteen water.
